codeReview.summary: tests/test_wrappers.py adds 30 well-structured tests across 11 classes covering all required validation assertions (VAL-WRAP-001 through VAL-WRAP-006, VAL-CROSS-001, VAL-CROSS-003/004/005). Tests are pure unit tests using unittest.mock.patch, follow project conventions (from __future__ import annotations, descriptive test names, one behavior per test), and correctly validate the existing BaseAgent._exec error handling, AgentResult dataclass, all 5 wrapper command constructions, ALL_AGENTS attribute completeness, and integration flow through the heuristic router. All 169 tests pass, ruff is clean for the new file, and no existing test files were modified.

issues.description: test_file_not_found_error_contains_binary_name calls BaseAgent._exec() directly where cls.binary is '' (BaseAgent's default). The error message becomes ' not found' (empty binary + ' not found'). The test passes because it checks 'not found' in result.error.lower(), but it doesn't actually verify the binary name is present. Calling through a concrete wrapper (e.g., ClaudeAgent) or asserting the full error string would make this test more precise.

Integration tests import route_and_run and VoxConfig inside the test function body rather than at module level. This works correctly and avoids potential import-time side effects, but is stylistically inconsistent with the rest of the file which uses top-level imports. Minor style concern only.

Non-zero exit tests use MagicMock for subprocess.CompletedProcess. While this works because MagicMock.stdout/stderr returns the assigned strings and .strip() works on them, using a real subprocess.CompletedProcess(args=[], returncode=2, stdout='...', stderr='...') or a SimpleNamespace would be more explicit and less reliant on mock magic.

summary: PASS. tests/test_wrappers.py adds 30 comprehensive tests (exceeding the 10+ requirement) across 11 well-organized classes. All validation assertions are fully covered: AgentResult dataclass (VAL-WRAP-001, 4 tests), _exec timeout handling (VAL-WRAP-002, 3 tests), _exec FileNotFoundError (VAL-WRAP-003, 3 tests), non-zero exit with stderr (VAL-WRAP-006, 4 tests), command construction for all 5 wrappers (VAL-WRAP-004, 11 tests), ALL_AGENTS attributes (VAL-WRAP-005, 4 tests), and integration flow through heuristic router (VAL-CROSS-001, 2 tests). Full suite passes (169/169), ruff clean, test_agents.py unmodified. Three non-blocking style issues noted: misleading test name for FileNotFoundError binary check, in-function imports in integration tests, and MagicMock used where real objects would be clearer.
